_comment: Orchestra renders this hook object in memory for each Codex launch, replacing __ORCHESTRA_BIN__ with the live orchestra binary path and __AGENT_ID__ with the adapter id, then writes it into the launch-scoped profile. It never changes the user's global Codex configuration. SessionStart supplies card orientation, Stop drains the durable inbox, and PermissionRequest opens an AgentRequest without changing turn status. The app-server observer owns turn state; the rollout tail supplies metadata.
